node.title: Structural Awareness — The Value of an Unresolved Frontier and Two-Phase Contextual Requalification
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: 1. The additional hypothesis is already in the foundational research, but at a different scope · 2. The mathematical objects and the meanings of "more useful" and "cheaper" · 3. Phase I — the source-representation relevance test.

relations: Qualified reuse can reduce the cost of clarity only after source production, discovery, integration, per-use verification and renewal costs are counted.
El criterio algebraico identifica una clase posible; no demuestra ahorro neto ni descubrimiento barato en campo.
Part I’s expressive and weak-information results lead to a separate utility and reconstruction problem; recognizing a limit does not supply the missing decoder.
Son construcciones matemáticas condicionadas y revisables; no una prueba de superioridad universal.
